CustomField.formula: IF( AND( DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(StartDate)), 12, 31) >= DATEVALUE(StartDate), DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(StartDate)), 12, 31) <= DATEVALUE(EndDate) ), DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(StartDate)), 12, 31), IF( AND( DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(EndDate)), 12, 31) >= DATEVALUE(StartDate), DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(EndDate)), 12, 31) <= DATEVALUE(EndDate) ), DATE(YEAR(DATEVALUE(EndDate)), 12, 31), NULL ) )
CustomField.label: Dec 31 Age Cutoff Date
